label: 蒙皮
description: 在 Geometry DSL 末尾追加 skin(skeleton=<ref>, ...) 一行，把可蒙皮网格绑定到骨架。mesh 缺省=对所有 part 合并网格自动蒙皮；method="auto"（测地体素绑定，平滑软体）或 "rigid"（最近单骨）。权重由前端按需求解，不写进 DSL。出现 skin 即触发角色路编译。
description-en: Append a `skin(skeleton=<ref>, ...)` line binding a skinnable mesh to the skeleton. mesh omitted = auto-skin the merged part mesh; method="auto" (geodesic voxel binding, smooth) or "rigid" (nearest single bone). Weights are solved on the frontend, not stored in the DSL.

inputs.name: mesh_id
inputs.label: 网格 id
inputs.description: 可蒙皮网格 mesh id（缺省=合并所有 part）

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.label: 体素分辨率
inputs.description: 体素分辨率启发值 32/48/64/128：实际控制前端测地求解器的顶点焊接容差（越高越保守，只焊真正重合/近重合的顶点，用于把分别 bake、互不共享顶点的各 part 缝进同一张连通图）
inputs.description-en: Voxel-resolution heuristic 32/48/64/128: in practice drives the geodesic solver's vertex-weld tolerance (higher = stricter, only welds near-coincident vertices — used to stitch separately-baked, non-shared-vertex parts into one connected graph).

inputs.name: max_influences
inputs.label: 每顶点骨数
inputs.description: 每顶点最大骨数 1..4（默认 2，低模更硬；要更软可调到 4）
inputs.description-en: Max bones per vertex 1..4 (default 2, firmer for low-poly; raise to 4 for softer blend).

inputs.name: falloff
inputs.label: 衰减指数
inputs.description: 权重随骨距衰减指数（越大越硬；默认 5，旧默认 4/2 偏软易扯形变）
inputs.description-en: Weight falloff exponent (higher = firmer; default 5; old defaults of 4/2 were softer / more stretchy).

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.description: 自定义 id；空=自动 skin{n}

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 追加 skin 行后的 Geometry
outputs.description-en: Geometry after appending the skin line.

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.description-en: Id of the new skin line.
